Manually set the role of one variable

Source: R/roles.R
sd_set_role.Rd

Overrides the role of a single variable in an sd_data object, e.g. after inspecting the result of sd_detect_roles() and finding a mistake.

Usage

sd_set_role(x, var, role)

Arguments

x

An sd_data object.

var

Name of the variable to set the role for.

role

One of "id", "likert", "nominal", "continuous", "date", "text", "weight", or "unknown".

Value

The same sd_data object, with the role for var updated.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
aineisto <- sd_set_role(aineisto, "tyovuodet", "continuous")
} # }
